items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: INTERVIEWER: We have one of your uncle playing with Paul and Albert Nicholas and Arnold Matoye at Tom Anderson's.

ctx.x: We have one of your uncle playing with Paul and Albert Nicholas and Arnold Matoye at Tom Anderson's. That picture.
Tom Anderson's, yeah. He worked there a good while. He also played the board. Stephen Capitol. I played Stephen Capitol too with Pierron.
